name: Ideas Fest 2026
tagline: The festival for business leaders and entrepreneurs

hours.afterDark: Evening programme runs until late on Wednesday 9 September; site closes 23:00 on Thursday 10 September

travel.road: Just off the A41, around 40 minutes from central London. Onsite parking is bookable in advance; off-site parking via Saba Park Services in Tring.
travel.rail: Nearest station is Tring (Avanti West Coast / London Northwestern), about 35 minutes from London Euston. A shuttle runs between Tring station and the venue.
travel.fromDocShed: From DocShed, Gwynedd allow roughly 4 hours by road (A55 → M56 → M6 → M1/A41). Aim to leave by 04:30 on Wednesday to make gates at 08:00, or travel Tuesday evening.

notes: All stages and most zones are covered, but this is a festival site: bring layers and boots for the fields.
Sessions are released and moved right up to the day. Re-check the official agenda each morning and re-import if anything shifts.
